checks.independent_hostile_probes: PASS normal/-O on final monitoring source; all six prior hostile mutations rejected.

checks.independent_monitoring_review: 7 targeted probes PASS normal/-O on unchanged source: exact records/error parity, ownership/fallback/thread/lifecycle checks.
